title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteering at Convoy of Hope, Springfield
description: This is a Giving Tuesday volunteer event at Convoy of Hope headquarters, sponsored by the Republic Area Chamber of Commerce, where volunteers count, sort, and box or bag product and may be split across different projects. Youth ages 10-17 may take part with parental consent, and 10-12 year olds must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian; closed-toe shoes and a current liability waiver are required. It runs Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM at the Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, Springfield, MO.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
